parameterNotes.container: the container that ran at its limit; the throttling counter is per container in the source system, and the corpus keeps one container's worth of it.

groundTruth.rootCauseReason: The container ran at its 500m CPU limit for eleven minutes, so every scheduling period was throttled and p99 latency rose from 180ms to 4.3s with no change in load.

rootCauseIndicators.description: throttling counters climbed for the whole window
quota fixed at 500m, which is what the usage was pinned against

causalChain.mechanism: the cgroup spent the whole window throttled, because usage sat at the fixed 500m quota
throttled request handling stretched p99 latency from 180ms to 4.3s while the load generator was unchanged

evidenceCheckpoints.description: the container quota the usage sat against, cited from the injection's own parameter rather than from prose
throttling counters climbed monotonically across the window
p99 latency at the peak, up from 180ms before the window

remediation.action: raise the CPU limit above the observed peak and confirm throttling stops

query: checkout-api p99 latency rose from 180ms to 4.3s over eleven minutes with no change in load; CPU throttling counters climbed the whole time. What failed, and why?
